profile.org_note: Single operating company run from Logan (2427 N Main Street; Builder lists the location as North Logan) with offices in Pleasant Grove and St. George and five sales regions; no division presidents are published. Since 2024 it is 51% owned by Japan's Misawa Homes Co., Ltd. through Misawa Homes America, Inc., so capital decisions sit with CEO Ryan Smith and the Misawa-controlled board that Jeff Jackson will chair from 2027-01-01. The CFO and the current land head are not named publicly; a January 2022 city record names Dallas Nicoll as Director of Land Development. Legal entity names are not confirmed: a job listing seen only in search results was posted by 'Visionary Homes (VHD, LLC)', and a property-records directory lists 'Visionary Homes 2020 LLC', '2024 LLC' and '2026 LLC' as buyers in the Logan area.
profile.summary: Utah production builder founded in 2004 in Logan, building single-family homes, townhomes and condos in about 24 communities from Cache Valley to St. George, with one Idaho community in Idaho Falls. Builder's 2026 list shows 600 closings and $286M revenue for 2025, down from 689 and $329M in 2024 (322 detached, 231 attached, 47 condos). It is a conventional for-sale builder, 51% owned by Misawa Homes of Japan since June 2024, with a new CEO (Ryan Smith, ex-Oakwood Homes, from 2026-09-01) and a stated goal of scaling toward 2,000 annual starts and entering neighboring markets.
